verdict_text:
YES

The script keeps, per 768-wide segment, the 64-column blocks for heads 0..4 and 6..11, which yields exactly the column ranges 0..319 and 384..767 offset by segment, in order, for both fused c_attn tensors. For c_proj.weight it applies the same selection on axis 0 with one segment, giving rows 0..319 and 384..767. All other tensors are left untouched, names are preserved, and the four required checks are asserted before writing a single safetensors file. The only external dependency is the local `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper, which I cannot inspect here, so the judgment assumes it returns the state dict with original dtypes intact.
